reason: YouTube with a 30-minute timer already works for me and costs nothing. I might try the free 14 days since there's no auto-charge, but I can't see myself paying for something I've always gotten free.
objection: I sleep with earphones in, so the smart fade and auto-resume mostly aren't for me. I'd just get a button on the lock screen, and that alone isn't worth paying for when YouTube is free and has endless sounds compared to 2 basic ones.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison actually showed I fall asleep a lot faster than with my usual 30-minute timer, I'd think about the yearly plan, but only at around 2,000 won a month.
